content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Tiruppur, is recruiting Staff Nurses under NHM Tamil Nadu on a temporary contract basis. The table below provides the key recruitment details for applicants. Register for Job Alerts Important: The notification states that the vacancy count may change. Candidates should check the official recruitment notice before submitting their applications.

rows.details: Department of Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Tamil Nadu
GNM or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognized institution
Registration with Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council
Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, 147, Pooluvapatti Pirivu, Nerupperichal Salai, Tiruppur - 641602

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applicants for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 must submit their completed application forms with supporting documents by the prescribed closing date. Applications may be delivered in person or sent through registered post.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Tiruppur, has advertised 122 temporary Staff Nurse vacancies for healthcare institutions under NHM Tamil Nadu. The recruitment is for nursing positions on a contractual basis. The notification specifies that the number of vacancies is subject to change.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 must possess the prescribed nursing qualification and professional registration. Applicants must have completed one of the following nursing qualifications: General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM). Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc Nursing). The nursing qualification must be obtained from a Government or Government-recognized institution. Yes. Candidates must be registered with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council . Applicants must submit the relevant nursing council registration certificate along with their application.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The notification specifies a maximum age limit of 50 years for the Staff Nurse posts.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates selected for the Staff Nurse posts will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 21,000 under NHM Tamil Nadu. The advertised engagement is temporary and contractual.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit copies of the required educational, identity and registration certificates along with their completed application form. The notification lists the following supporting documents. Applicants must self-attest the copies of supporting documents submitted with the application. Candidates claiming special-category status should include the relevant certificate.

rows.requirement: Course mark sheets and consolidated mark sheet
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council registration certificate
10th or 12th Standard Tamil subject certificate / mark sheet
Voter ID, Aadhaar Card or Family Card
Certificate from a Group A or Group B Government Officer, as prescribed
Revenue Divisional Officer certificate, if applicable
Certificate from the competent medical authority, if applicable
Certificate issued by the Social Welfare Department, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply offline for the DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse posts. The completed application form and supporting documents should reach the District Health Society office by 26 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Visit the official Tiruppur district recruitment page at https://tiruppur.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/ . Find the DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse recruitment notification and application form. Read the eligibility requirements and application instructions. Complete the application form with the requested personal, educational and nursing registration details. Attach self-attested copies of the required supporting documents. Check that the application and certificates are complete. Submit the application in person or send it through registered post to the notified address. Ensure the application reaches the office by 26 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Application Form Submission Address
content_sections.text: Applicants must send or submit their applications to the following address: Executive Secretary / District Health Officer , District Health Society, 147, Pooluvapatti Pirivu, Nerupperichal Salai, Tiruppur - 641602, Tamil Nadu. Contact Number: 0421-2478503 Submission Method: In person or registered post. Deadline: 26 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. 1. How many vacancies are available in DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DHS Tiruppur has advertised 122 Staff Nurse vacancies under the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu. The vacancy count may change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for DHS Tiruppur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 26 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess GNM or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognized institution and hold registration with the Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council.

faq.question: Q4. Can GNM-qualified candidates apply for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse vacancies?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have completed the General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) course and meet the nursing council registration and other conditions can apply.

faq.question: Q5. Can B.Sc Nursing graduates apply for DHS Tiruppur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with B.Sc Nursing from a recognized institution and the required nursing council registration are eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 50 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Selected Staff Nurses will receive consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 21,000.

faq.question: Q8. Is DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates must submit the completed form in person or by registered post to the District Health Society office.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates submit the DHS Tiruppur Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, 147, Pooluvapatti Pirivu, Nerupperichal Salai, Tiruppur - 641602.
